description_en: This API is used to query the history of major version upgrade jobs for RDS PostgreSQL instances.
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS PostgreSQL实例大版本升级的历史任务
name: DescribeUpgradeMajorVersionTasks

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 30 to 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。

取值：30~100。

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Pages start from 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The major engine version of the new instance. Valid values:

10.0
11.0
12.0
13.0
14.0
15.0
parameters.name: target_major_version

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: task_id
